title: Health
hero_body: Sleep, steps, heart rate, weight and diet, answered from the health data on your phone. Chats and memory here are kept apart from Persona's other chats.
suggestion_sleep: How did I sleep this week?
suggestion_steps: How do my last 7 days of steps compare to the week before?
suggestion_heart: Has my resting heart rate changed lately?
empty_body: Ask a question above to start the first one.
source_phone_body: Steps, sleep, heart rate, weight and more, read through your phone. The Persona app needs to be open on it.
source_write_body: Say “log my weight” or “I drank 300 ml of water”; it's saved to Health after you confirm on the phone.
source_upload_body: Send a photo; each item is read out and the ones outside the reference range are marked.
memory_empty: Nothing yet. Goals, allergies, medication and the like remembered in health chats show up here.
privacy_separate: Health chats stay here: Persona's other chats can't see or read them.
privacy_memory: Health memory is kept on its own and never flows into other chats; you can view and delete it any time.
privacy_where: Chats and memory stay on the hub's machine and don't go into the knowledge base.
privacy_doctor: This gives explanations and suggestions; it doesn't replace a doctor's diagnosis or treatment.
